searchText: I appear to be facing issues using the zhejiang ETH faucet while behind a VPN/proxy/mainland China GFW (or perhaps the faucet is temporarily having issues?). If anyone is able to help me obtain 3201 zhejiang ETH for testing CLWP scenarios on capella, I'd greatly appreciate any help (even 32.1 would be appreciated). 0x85A0c86944b1d7e1119B7C93ad2b771480561AE3 https://zhejiang.beaconcha.in/tx/0x80846c0b7159680d3e5c5e2b378274993088d98abccbb90e87be8ab3aa0f6bbb let's go zhejiang! 🙂 <@412614104222531604> i too having issue with faucet it not working maybe due to load don't know, would be great if you can send few hundreds eth for testing Address - 0xD2ed9651d3B28f1eeE08B297339914ca7d8171c2 There are 3 different faucets. Please try with all. Can you please share them, i can see only one on the page Head over to ethstaker and look for Zhejiang channel please. https://discord.gg/R8UjugW8 CLWP is now accepting submissions for Zhejiang validators to broadcast the BLSChangeToExecution message: https://github.com/benjaminchodroff/ConsensusLayerWithdrawalProtection We welcome volunteers to load these messages into their nodes to help broadcast them as well. "Gossip via GitHub" thank you!
